evidence.source_statement: When a project's MVP includes a reusable library or agent-facing API, confirm it works with an independent consuming application or integration before inaugurating that interface.
source_conditions: An authorized MVP readiness, graduation, release, or follow-up review is in progress.
source_exceptions: Does not independently authorize a tag, release or external deployment.
